english.title: Proceeds of Crime - prejudice investigation
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), knowing or suspecting that a

(A)_[confiscation investigation]_
(B)_[civil recovery investigation]_
(C)_[money laundering investigation]_
(D)_[detained cash investigation]_

(E)_[was being]_
(F)_[was about to be]_

conducted by an appropriate officer,

(G)_[made a disclosure which was likely to prejudice the investigation]_
(H)_[falsified, concealed, destroyed or otherwise disposed of documents relevant to the investigation]_
(I)_[caused the falsification, concealment, destruction or disposal of documents relevant to the investigation]_
(J)_[permitted the falsification, concealment, destruction or disposal of documents relevant to the investigation]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section342 of the Proceeds of Crime Act 2002.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) This offence should only be used for offences committed between 6th April 2008 to 5th April 2010. For offences committed outside of these dates, please see offence documents H101661 (6th April 2010 to 30th January 2018), H101662 (31st January 2018 to 25th April 2024) and H101659 (26th April 2024 onwards). For offences previous to this date please see H5064 (24th February 2003 and 5th April 2008).
(ii) This offence document applies from the 6th April 2008 due to changes made by the Serious Crime Act 2007 which expanded the remit of the offence to cover detained cash investigations. For the offence applying before this date, see H5064.(iii) See subsections 342(3)and (6) for circumstances in which a person does not commit this offence.
(iv) See subsection 342(4) for an explanation of when a disclosure falls within this section.
(v) MoPI group cannot be established from the offence code alone. Group 2 or 3 may apply depending on the nature of the related crimes. Manual MoPI review is required.

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: maximum 6 months imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: maximum 5 years imprisonment and/or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
